headline: Best angle in the area today but it's small and short-period — a fun log session.
today: Swell's the same size as everywhere but Lido gets a better S angle, so expect the cleanest shape of the local beaches. WSW cross is lightest mid-morning before the SW cross-on builds through the afternoon and the SSE onshore ruins it by evening. Get on it early with a log around the morning tide push. Waist-high and playful, not much more.

daysToWatch.note: Cross-off NW/W winds clean it up but the swell's dropped to knee-to-waist. Small and glassy, log territory.
Flat and howling NW 15-17mph cross-off. Nothing to ride.
Still flat with strong NW. Skip.
